caseName: Metropolitan Edison Co. v. People Against Nuclear Energy
caseNameFull: Metropolitan Edison Co. v. People Against Nuclear Energy and United States Nuclear Regulatory Commission v. People Against Nuclear Energy

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motions of Atomic Industrial Forum, American Mining Congress, and Chamber of Commerce of the United States for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 219 U. S. App. D. C. 358, 678 F. 2d 222.
